title: Related Party Transactions
summary: Related Party Transactions is part of the Accounting Standards for Private Enterprises (ASPE).
description: This standard is part of the ASPE framework issued by the Canadian Accounting Standards Board. It provides guidance on related party transactions.

bannerNotice.title: Prescribes Measurement, Not Just Disclosure
bannerNotice.body: Unlike IAS 24, which is disclosure-only, ASPE Section 3840 actively prescribes a measurement basis – carrying amount or, in narrower circumstances, exchange amount.
